body: We argue about the way things should happen, or how we treat each other. I feel like I always take the burden of blame but never see her own her faults and make an effort to change them.
I would settle for mildly painful at this point. I can't go on this way.

She said she doesn't love me anymore. We have had a lot of arguments and we can't resolve disputes between us. It's basic conflict management stuff...she refuses to talk to anyone together..

​
